the experience of sadness and anger influences causal judgments in opposite ways.

the influence of emotions on social judgment and the mechanisms underlying such effects.
the effects of sadness and of anger on social perception.

sadness and anger are associated with different social perceptions.

sadness and anger are not the same, and that they do not influence social judgments in the same way.

sadness makes people more sensitive to situational causes and anger makes them more sensitive to human causes.
